question_summary: Subcontractor requests approval to substitute PVC piping for the specified cast-iron roof drain leader in Section 22 14 00 prior to placing a material order, citing supplier lead times.
proposed_solution: Use PVC pipe as an alternate to the specified cast-iron roof drain leader; submitter states this is cost-neutral and will not affect the domestic water pressure test date.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: The request involves a material substitution for a specified plumbing system component (roof drain leader), requiring review and approval by the plumbing engineer of record.
